templates.title: Standard Employee Paystub
templates.description: The standard paystub for a regular, ongoing employee. This template calculates standard withholdings (federal/state tax, FICA) and is suitable for most traditional employment relationships with a consistent schedule.
templates.author: System

templates.title: Independent Contractor Invoice & Earnings Statement
templates.description: Designed for 1099 contractors, this template functions as both an invoice for services rendered and an earnings summary. It highlights gross pay without traditional employee tax withholdings, emphasizing it is not a W-2 wage statement.
templates.author: System
